offer_text: Rum Club runs its happy hour Sunday through Thursday, 4-7pm, with rotating drink specials and $1 off menu bites at the bar. Grab a stool early, before the after-work crowd claims them.

Happy hour at Breakside runs Sunday through Thursday, 3-6pm: $1 off house-brewed pints plus $2 select sides, $4 apps, and a $6 cheeseburger or steamed mussels. There's a late-night repeat, too, if you keep odd hours.

Wayfinder pours happy hour Monday through Thursday, 3-5pm, and all day Sunday: $1 off house beers alongside wings, chicharrones, and jalapeno popper rangoons. The lagers are the ones locals argue about.

St. Jack keeps a bar-only happy hour daily, 4-6pm, plus a late seating 10pm to close, with drink specials and a menu that lets you taste the French kitchen's greatest hits for a fraction of dinner prices.

Downtown's original beer bar runs happy hour daily, 3-6pm (and again evenings): 20% off drinks and $5-$7 bar snacks. It's the civilized way to sample a Portland institution without the white-tablecloth bill.

Screen Door Eastside runs happy hour Monday through Friday, 4:30-5:30pm and 8pm to close: $2 off drafts, $5 house wine and wells, and Southern bar plates. Best odds of a seat without the legendary brunch line.
Palomar pours a daily happy hour with $6 frozen daiquiris, the house specialty. Croquetas, empanadas, and palm-tree wallpaper included; it's the closest thing to a Havana afternoon on NW 23rd.

Hey Love runs happy hour Monday through Friday, 3-5pm: $10 classic cocktails plus discounted apps, wine, and draft beer in the jungle-lush room off Burnside. Walk-in only, so come early and stay for the plants.

Prost! runs a weekday happy hour on its German drafts and steins, spilling out into the Mississippi Avenue beer garden and the food-cart pod behind it. Good prices, better pretzels, weather permitting.
